_comment: Martial NPC class, hand-written from ./outline. Extra attacks at 5/10/15/20 (attacksPerLevel), ASIs (feats) at 2/7/12/18, a random saving throw proficiency (Tenacity) at 1/6/11/16, and a random armor or weapon proficiency it lacks (Combat Training) at 3/8/13/19, and d8 hit dice. It starts with simple weapons and no armor, so its gear follows the proficiencies it rolls.
